title: Custom Football Engulfed in Flames and Lightning Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with this custom-designed comforter set from Jeminise. This sporty bedding features a high-quality graphic of a football engulfed in flames and lightning, making it an excellent gift for football players, coaches, and passionate fans who want to bring the excitement of the game into their home decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with options for text inputs, such as entering a custom name and number to make it uniquely yours.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a lightweight, soft, and durable sleeping experience.
  • Cozy Comforter Option: Features a whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping and shifting, providing breathable warmth for all seasons.
  • Duvet Cover Option: A lightweight option designed with a hidden zipper closure, making it easy to insert, remove, and wash.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Optional Pillowcases: Complete your sports-themed bed set with matching optional pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick to dry, and engineered to hold dye and prevent fading.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Selected Design Fire & Thunder Football
Theme Football
Seasons All
Included Components 1 Duvet Cover (or Comforter) + (Optional) Pillowcases
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
